name: shesafe
description: SheSafe - personal safety and emergency-response product (Flask API + vanilla ES-module PWA)

scripts.seed: python3 -c "from backend.app.seed import ensure_seed; from backend.app.config import load_config; ensure_seed('backend/data/shesafe.db', load_config())"

author: SheSafe Team

comments.dependencies: Intentionally empty. The runtime is Python 3.10+ with Flask only; `npm install` is not required to run SheSafe. See backend/requirements.txt.
comments.devDependencies: jsdom powers tests/frontend/smoke.mjs, which runs the real client module graph against a live server to verify the browser contract. Development only.
comments.type: So Node treats tests/frontend/*.mjs as ES modules. The browser frontend uses native modules and is unaffected. backend/server.cjs is CommonJS by extension.
comments.tests: npm run test = pytest suite; npm run test:frontend = jsdom browser-contract test that boots the real client module graph against a live server.
